title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Cancellation, Late Arrival and No-Show Terms by Pass
content:
These are the Tailwise Grooming Salon figures for cancelling a booked appointment and for arriving late or not at all, pass by pass.

| Pass | Free-cancellation notice | Late-cancellation fee (USD) | Late cancellation forfeits a visit | No-show forfeits a visit | Late-arrival grace |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 24 hours | 15.00 | no | yes | 15 minutes |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 24 hours | 15.00 | no | yes | 15 minutes |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 24 hours | 20.00 | no | yes | 15 minutes |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 24 hours | 20.00 | no | yes | 15 minutes |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 48 hours | 25.00 | no | yes | 15 minutes |
| Groom Club Monthly | 24 hours | 0.00 | yes | yes | 15 minutes |

**Column definitions**

- *Free-cancellation notice* — the notice before the appointment's start time at or above which cancelling or rescheduling is free.
- *Late-cancellation fee* — the pass's late-cancellation fee figure for a cancellation made with less notice.
- *Late cancellation forfeits a visit* — whether a late cancellation forfeits a visit instead of a fee.
- *No-show forfeits a visit* — whether a no-show forfeits one visit.
- *Late-arrival grace* — the minutes after the appointment's start time within which a late arrival is still serviced; a later arrival is a no-show.

**Reading the figures (hypothetical)**

- On the Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit, a cancellation recorded 47 full hours before the start time is under the 48-hour notice; one recorded 48 full hours before is not.
- A pet arriving 15 minutes after its start time is within the grace; one arriving 16 minutes after is not.
